meta.name: report
meta.description: Submit feedback to the template repo as a GitHub issue (bug, feature request, or confusion)

copy.tagline: 向模板仓库提交反馈为 GitHub Issue
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在模板仓库中提交 bug、功能建议或疑问
copy.tagline_en: Submit feedback to a template repo as a GitHub issue
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to submit bug reports, feature requests, or questions to a template repository

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你向模板仓库提交 GitHub Issue，报告 Bug、提功能建议或反馈困惑。它会引导你描述问题、分类，并直接创建 Issue 或生成预填链接。
howto.when: 当你说“这个不工作”、“我卡住了”、“我希望它能做 X”或直接输入 /report 时触发。

say.text: 这个模板的 /meeting 技能报错了。
say.note: Claude 会引导你分类并创建 Bug Issue。

say.text: 我希望模板能增加一个日历同步功能。
say.note: Claude 会引导你提交功能请求。

say.text: 我搞不懂怎么配置自定义技能。
say.note: Claude 会引导你提交困惑反馈。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you submit a GitHub Issue to the template repository for bugs, feature requests, or confusion. It guides you through describing the issue, categorizing it, and either creates the issue directly or generates a pre-filled URL.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "this doesn't work", "I got stuck", "I wish this did X", or run /report directly.

say_en.text: The /meeting skill in this template is broken.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to categorize and create a Bug issue.

say_en.text: I wish the template had a calendar sync feature.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to submit a feature request.

say_en.text: I can't figure out how to configure custom skills.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to submit a confusion feedback.
